const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack/tools/audio-trim-silence.mjs
@@
     const inputPath = `${AUDIO_DIR}/${file.name}`;
     const tempPath = `${AUDIO_DIR}/.${file.name}.tmp`;
+    const backupPath = `${AUDIO_DIR}/.${file.name}.original`;
*** Add File: /home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack/.agents/skills/audio-processing/SKILL.md
+---
+name: audio-processing
+description: Process newly added JSHack audio assets by trimming silence and compressing MP3s.
+argument-hint: <audio-file-or-new-assets>
+---
+
+# Audio processing
+
+Use this skill when new MP3 or WAV files are added under `assets/audio/` and
+need production-sized files without changing existing assets.
+
+## Workflow
+
+1. Identify only the newly added files with `git status --short`.
+2. Inspect duration, bitrate, sample rate, and channels with `ffprobe`.
+3. Measure leading/trailing silence with `ffmpeg` using `silencedetect=noise=-50dB:d=0.1`.
+4. Process the selected files with `ffmpeg` using:
+   - leading and trailing silence removal at `-50 dB` after 100 ms;
+   - `loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11`;
+   - MP3 encoding at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, stereo.
+5. Write to a temporary file, then replace only the selected source file.
+6. Re-run `ffprobe` and compare sizes and durations. Do not run the batch process
+   over the whole library for a small incremental asset change.
+
+The repository helpers are `tools/audio-trim-silence.mjs` and
+`tools/audio-normalize-compress.mjs`; `deno task audio:trim-silence` is the
+focused trim entry point. The trim helper uses `manifest.csv` to avoid
+reprocessing files already recorded there.
+
+## Validation
+
+```bash
+deno test --allow-read tests/audioSoundsRegistry.test.mjs tests/audioNewSounds.test.js
+deno task check
+```
+
+Keep generated backups and manifests out of the asset directory unless the
+task explicitly calls for them. Never process pre-existing audio just because
+it is present in the directory.
*** End Patch";
